decision: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
event_name: Aston Martin Red Bull Racing Document 7 Date 20 July 2018 Time 11:41 2018 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 19 - 22 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 6), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 3rd Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K), 3rd Energy Store (ES) and 3rd Control Electronics (CE) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Articles 23.3 a) and 23.3 b). The team notified the Technical Delegate regarding the change of the power unit elements on the 16th July, at 13:52.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 7 2018 German Grand Prix Offence Car 3 Power Unit Elements
